text: Absorbed spatial analysis into the unified mvpa module: SpatialAxes, ROI/parcellation/searchlight frame builders, typed spatial renditions, and result scattering now live directly under modules/mvpa. The separate mvpa-spatial module surface and README are gone; no feature-set compatibility layer remains. Focused spatial courts passed 12/12 on JVM and 12/12 on Scala.js; diff check clean.
